name: gavinerickson/workflow-configurator
description: Operator-editable workflow graphs over Symfony Workflow: definitions, places and transitions as Doctrine entities, compiled into workflows at runtime.

suggest.easycorp/easyadmin-bundle: The admin CRUD, Mermaid diagram and guided transition form register only when EasyAdmin is present
suggest.symfony/workflow: The runtime registry compiles enabled definitions into Workflow/StateMachine objects
suggest.symfony/asset-mapper: Ships the dependent from/to selects for the transition form
